about: Which schemas/devices/<dir> each vendor oracle covers, read by tools/crossval-gate.py. Every directory under schemas/devices must appear under 'ttn' or 'not_cross_validated', so a new vendor directory forces a decision rather than silently escaping the gate. Each TTN name was checked against vendor/ in TheThingsNetwork/lorawan-devices at the commit pinned in tools/crossval-baseline.json.

not_cross_validated._language-conformance: Construct fixtures, not devices: no vendor publishes a codec for them.
not_cross_validated._library-composed: Generated by tools/compose_library_vectors.py from schemas/library definition catalogues; no vendor device corresponds.

notes.decentlab: The TTN oracle reports 57 of 58 decentlab schemas as disagreeing only because TTN's declared outputs wrap each value as {displayName, unit, value} while the schema emits the bare value; the value comparison is the decentlab-decoders oracle's job. The TTN entry is kept because a payload that stops decoding at all is still caught there (crossval-gate.py counts decode failures separately from disagreements).
